images.01: Cozy student dorm room at night: Uzbek student girl Madina, 20, yellow headscarf, pajamas, lying in bed hugging her smartphone plugged into a charger, smiling as the screen shows a full battery, books on the nightstand, warm lamp light.
images.02: Cartoon personified smartphone with a cute tired face and droopy eyes lying on a nightstand plugged into a charger, sweating, with a small bandage, cozy dark room, funny and sympathetic.
images.02_b: SMALL CHANGE: same picture, but the phone now holds up a tiny white flag and its eyes are wide open in panic.
images.03: Uzbek student Madina, 20, yellow headscarf, in a university corridor looking in shock at her phone showing a red low battery icon at noon, friends walking past.
images.04: Small phone repair kiosk in a Tashkent market: repairman Rustam aka, 40, short beard, glasses on his forehead, apron, holding a phone battery with tweezers and explaining, shelves with phone parts, warm light.
images.05: Infographic-style illustration of a smartphone battery cut in half showing glowing cells, a green zone from 20 to 80 percent and red zones at 0 and 100 percent, dark blue background, clean and simple.
images.06: Uzbek student Madina with yellow headscarf at her desk turning on a battery-saving setting on her phone, the personified phone smiling happily, notebook and tea beside her.
images.07: Morning: Uzbek student Madina with yellow headscarf walking cheerfully to university, her happy cartoon phone peeking from her bag pocket and waving, sunny autumn street with plane trees.
